response.justification: While the candidate demonstrates strong software engineering practices, mentorship capabilities, and experience with large-scale systems, they critically lack the 8 years of C++ experience required as a minimum qualification (only ~6 months documented at National Instruments in 2014-2015). Their career trajectory is primarily in web, backend, and full-stack development rather than infrastructure, cloud platforms, or compute system architecture. They also lack preferred qualifications including an advanced degree and specific cloud/DevOps technical leadership experience.
strengths: Strong emphasis on software craftsmanship, TDD, and engineering best practices with demonstrated mentoring through workshops and code kata sessions
Proven experience managing large-scale distributed systems (microservices handling millions of requests at Dunnhumby) and current Staff Engineer role showing seniority progression
Demonstrated ability to own and drive complex technical projects to completion (GISCollective founder, multiple open-source libraries) with evidence of establishing best practices
concerns: Critical gap: Only ~6 months of documented C++ experience versus required 8 years minimum (National Instruments Dec 2014-June 2015), failing to meet core qualification
Career trajectory focused on web, backend, and full-stack development rather than infrastructure, cloud platforms, or compute system architecture
Missing preferred qualifications including advanced degree (Master's/PhD) and no clear evidence of technical leadership specifically mentoring cloud or DevOps engineers

key_factors.factor: Software engineering practices and mentoring capability
